roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN) to join a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD. This vital role combines the responsibilities of staff education and maintaining robust infection prevention and control programs.

As the SDC/Infection Control Nurse, you will be instrumental in ensuring our team is well-trained and our facility adheres to the highest standards of health and safety. You will develop and implement educational programs for staff and oversee all aspects of infection control to protect both residents and employees.

This is an excellent opportunity for an RN passionate about staff development and public health within a supportive environment. We offer a competitive hourly rate and the chance to make a significant impact on our facility's quality of care.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Minimum of 2 years of experience in staff development or education within a healthcare setting
Minimum of 2 years of experience in infection prevention and control
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations related to long-term care and infection control
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, commensurate with experience.
